name: sync-me
description: Interactive, grill-style teaching sessions for people working with coding agents: unstick one confusing point, catch up on a long session, walk through a task only the user can do, or answer the decisions an agent left waiting.

plugins.name: sync-me
plugins.description: Four modes. Unstick: find the point that lost you and teach it one part per turn with recall checks. Catch-up: rebuild a long session's context and teach it top-down. Walk: one verified step at a time for tasks only you can execute. Decide: pull the decisions an agent left for you out of its reply and ask them one at a time, each with a recommendation and what each option costs. Includes an optional Stop hook for decide mode, off until you turn it on.
